test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

“You can meet me always you like,” our teacher told us.
solution: The erroneous part is **'me always'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • This sentence is an example of **an adverb error.** • Here, '**me whenever**' should be used instead of '**me always**'. • The adverb '**whenever**' means '**at whatever time**'. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct Sentence:__** *"You can meet **me whenever **you like," our teacher told us.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यह वाक्य **adverb error **का एक उदाहरण है। • यहां '**me** **always**' के स्थान पर '**me whenever**' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • **Adverb** '**whenever**' का अर्थ है 'जो भी समय'। • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3** है। 40:Ta68, The correct answer is '**End**'.
